notes.title: Linux update!
notes.content: [p]Hello! After running a native linux branch for a few days we've decided to go back to using proton on the main game build for now. Future work on a linux native build will continue in a proper experimental branch.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're interested in that, please hop into the discord channel! ❤️[/p]

notes.title: 1.2.5 hotfix
notes.content: [list][*][p]made the Daily achievement progress trigger when your Daily run ENDS, instead of when it starts[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]fixed a bug that was making the Daily achievement progress pop up on launch, instead of just when you make progress[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a few miscellaneous bugs earlier this week too but I'm not gonna make separate patch notes about those[/p][/*][/list]

[h2]Content[/h2][list][*][p]daily artifacts you’ve seen are now listed at the bottom of the codex[/p][/*][*][p]added Polish and Ukrainian glyphs to our font to support fan translations[/p][/*][*][p]A whole bunch of bugfixes, listed below[/p][/*][*][p]quietly added a Mac version (let us know in the discord if you try it!)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]you can no longer start the rail cannon fight lodged inside the wall[/p][/*][*][p]Rebound Reagent can no longer proc multiple times in a single fight if you save+quit+reload[/p][/*][*][p]Dillian on enemy-shufflin' dailies can no longer shuffle his extend action to BEFORE he attacks, which let him shoot you in ways you wouldn't see coming[/p][/*][*][p]Combustion Engine doesn't render its actions weird when you have hermes boots[/p][/*][*][p]the status Engine Lock is now correctly labeled as “affected by Timestop” while you have Timestop[/p][/*][*][p]the Janitorbot and the Rail Cannon now obey RNG seeding properly and have consistent starting positions[/p][/*][*][p]you can now peek your draw/discard/exhaust pile during another UI (think Admin Deploy B or EXE cards)[/p][/*][*][p]choosing a card from your hand (Admin Deploy B) now shows the cards in the same order they are in your hand[/p][/*][*][p]Second Opinions now draws cards in the order they are in your draw pile - if your Jupiter’s Moons is on top of the draw pile, it will be drawn first - might matter if your hand is almost full[/p][/*][*][p]fixed Boss Advantage / Draft Pick daily run modifier timing issue[/p][/*][*][p]fixed upgrade arrow color if Only B Upgrades daily run modifier is up[/p][/*][*][p]the game now attempts to view non-English leaderboard names in their appropriate fonts if possible, and falls back to replacing unknown characters with `?` (they used to just be blank)[/p][/*][*][p]long leaderboard names now get an ellipsis[/p][/*][*][p]fixed daily run modifiers not being saved if the game is closed via the X button right after starting a run, but before getting to the first fight[/p][/*][*][p]fixed card tooltips appearing for a single frame when they're disabled while playing on a controller[/p][/*][*][p]some optimizations related to artifacts[/p][/*][*][p]some miniscule RNG changes (RNG no longer called if choosing 1 out of 1 items)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content:
[list]

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h2][b]CONTENT:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a daily mode![/b]
[*]     Everyone playing that day’s daily share a crew, a ship, and a run seed.  They also share 1-3 weird modifiers that make daily runs feel pretty different from normal runs!
[*]     Dailies are scored!  Compete with your friends on the Steam leaderboards!
[*]     Daily runs are available after beating the game, OR by opting in early (and accepting that dailies may contain story/mechanic spoilers!)
[*] Here’s a few examples of daily modifiers:
[list][*]     One character only!
[*]     Enemy ship parts are randomly shuffled at the start of every fight!
[*]     Start with extra health, but most fights take place in Solar Flare events- you’re gonna need the health
[*]     Cards can only be upgraded to their B upgrade
[*]     Start with a free boss artifact[/list][/list][h2][b]MISC:[/b][/h2][list]
[*] Ship health bars now have slightly darker ticklines every 5th tick, to make it easier to tell at a glance how much health an enemy has
[*] Made the card “Release” a dual card- you can now choose if the object you’re releasing is pointed TOWARD or AWAY from you
[/list][h2][b]BUGFIXES:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Made it so getting the status “LOSE ALL YOUR EVADE NEXT TURN” plays a sad sound instead of a happy one
[*] Fixed some other really minor stuff that’s too boring to list
[/list]

Lastly, [b][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/riggs-plushie]we're doing a Makeship campaign for a Riggs plushie!!![/url][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43508163/41c0daef6d21b66a6cdd24fa0b58fc8dcc7b34c3.png[/img]
Look at her. Incredible. I want one.
This campaign only goes until September 18th, so grab one while you can!!!

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.1.2
notes.content:
[h1]PLAYER SHIP CHANGES[/h1][list]
[*] Ares starts with 1 less hull and 1 less max shield  (now 8/4)
[*] Tiderunner starts with 1 less hull (now 7/3)
[*] Jupiter starts with 2 more hull and 1 more max shield (now 12/4)
[/list]
[h1]ENEMY CHANGES[/h1][list]
[*] Wizbo / The Tower can no longer be in a Solar Flare environment if you entered the fight with 3 or less hull 🧙‍♂️ 🔥
[*] Janitorbot / CST-7 "Minesweeper" has 2 less hull and 2 less shield
[*] Rider / The Solar Sail has 2 less shield
[*] X.05 / Rail Cannon puts out a little bit less damage in phases 2 and 3
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES / MISC[/h1][list]
[*] Added a second backup save system just for people whose computers crashed mid-save.  Now, if your save is corrupted, you can revert to the backup made every time you return to the New Run screen
[*] Fixed a visual oddity where gaining lots of Max Shard would make the status row harder to read
[*] X.05 / Rail Cannon now gains 99 Perfect Shield when scrunching and loses it all when unscrunching, instead of 1.  This fixes a strange interaction where it would retain its Perfect Shield into the next turn if it tried changing fight phases mid-turn (via taking damage from space mines, payback, heat, etc)
[*] A few miscellaneous bugfixes
[/list]

Eagle-eyed players might notice we pushed a few of these changes a few days ago (specifically, the player ship modifications) without an official announcement.  We were testing them out!  Reception was positive and the changes seem to have done exactly what we were hoping they'd do, so they're staying.  :)

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.1.1
notes.content:
(Lumping the last two hotfixes into this update!)
[h1]BALANCE CHANGES
[/h1]
[list]
[*] Solar Sail: one missile intent has been swapped from heavy missiles to normal missiles
[*] Rail Cannon:  All phases now have 10hp instead of 11
[*] Rail Cannon:  All multi-hit attacks now cap at 1x2 instead of 1x3
[*] Minesweeper:  on Hardest, gained +3 hull, +3 shields, but is no longer armored  (now +2/+2 compared to normal)
[*] Replicator: Main cannon starts with +1 damage and can go up to 5 max damage (instead of 4)
[*] reworked the card Quantum Quarry's upgrades:
  [*] Quantum Quarry A now also retains
  [*] Quantum Quarry B has been completely reworked; it instead gives +1 max shard
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1- more enemies!
notes.content:
[h1]CONTENT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Six new enemies:
[list]
[*] 3 new normal enemies, one per zone!
[*] One new elite for zone 2
[*] A new alternate Zone 1 boss
[*] A new alternate Zone 2 boss[/list]
[*] Duncan the skunk, pilot of the Mining Drill, has been upgraded from NORMAL to ELITE enemy.[list]
[*] That’s because he kills players more often than any other non-boss fight! Watch out for this guy![/list]
[*] One new common artifact: Chaff Emitters
[/list]
[h1]BUGFIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a graphical bug in the Hardest version of the big crystal fight
[*] A few smaller fixes on really weird, niche edge cases
[/list]
[h1]MISC[/h1]
[list]
[*] Renamed a status from “DRAW LESS NEXT TURN” to “SHAKEN”
[*] New splash art by Justin Chan! Look at it!!!
[*] Updated credits
[/list]
[h1]NOTES[/h1]
In the interest of keeping the game’s initial learning curve the same, all the new enemies can only show up after you’ve played or won a few runs.  Pre-existing save files that have already done this will already have access to the new enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43508163/6a161c9f6385a01c46a6436d7be992a4cfeab429.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.7
notes.content:
[h1]1.0.7 changes
[/h1][h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] The card Escape Artist has been reworked and buffed a bit; it no longer discards any cards from your hand
[/list][h2]Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tooth now has a talking animation
[/list][h2]Misc[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a longstanding bug that made the Soggins event incorrectly count as 5 unique events in the event progress bar (whoops!)
[*] several dozen small bugs have been fixed
[*] the main change:  big under-the-hood changes to how enemies work, which should be completely unnoticeable to the average player
[*] these changes are the last ones we needed to make for some very cool upcoming content later this summer 😎
[/list]

If you were in the middle of a fight when your save file was transferred to 1.0.7, the enemy you were fighting might behave a little oddly!  Once you start a new fight, everything should be back to normal 👍

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.6
notes.content:
CONTENT:

[list]
New event!  (It’s a very fun one.)  ⚽
Duncan, the pilot of the Mining Drill, overcame his shyness and can now talk
5 new artifacts:
[list]
Tiderunner’s starting artifact has been split into 2 artifacts, to be easier to parse
Tiderunner now has a boss artifact, meaning all 5 ships have boss artifacts :)
new Dizzy artifact
new Max artifact
new Isaac boss artifact
[/list]
[/list]

BALANCE SHIFTS:

[list]
Made Caffeine Rush cap at 2 triggers per turn
Heavily reworked Jupiter’s boss artifact
Instead of “your Jupiter Drone card now costs 0”, it is now:
If there are no Jupiter Drones currently in the midrow: when you launch a Jupiter Drone, gain 1 energy
Gemini now starts with one new extra card, Basic Swap
If a bubbled drone is launched into a midrow object, the bubble takes the hit first. This means Brac is more dangerous! Watch out!
[/list]

INTERNAL CHANGES:

[list]
Reworked how a few artifacts worked internally
Reworked how a lot of enemy code works
Essentially, did a bunch of work under the hood, so we can do more cool stuff in the future
[/list]

BUG FIXES:

[list]
From Hell’s Heart B can no longer kill you if you play it twice through Max + Zero Doubler shenanigans
Fixed a rare case where Sticky Note and Safety Lock could be wasted buffing temporary cards
Fixed that **Heal Booster** would also boost enemy healing (only relevant once, but still: whoops!!)
Various other smaller bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.5
notes.content:
GRAPHICAL CHANGES:

[list]
[*] Some Max cards got some cool new art!
[*] “Autopilot” icon art change
[*] “Clean Exhaust” icon art change
[/list]

BALANCE CHANGES:

[list]
[*] swapped the rarity of two Riggs cards:
[*] “Selective Memory” is now Uncommon
[*] “Second Opinions” is now Rare
[/list]

BUG FIXES:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed cards to be played while they were still animating into your hand
[*] Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause Perpetual Motion Device to not draw a card
[*] Fixed a niche case where you could click the on-screen left/right arrows to move when you weren’t supposed to be able to
[*] A few mid-combat shouts require slightly more specific scenarios to trigger
[*] Fixed a rare bug that was causing players’ saves to break right as they beat the zone 3 boss
[*] ESC no longer steps through run summary screens
[/list]

MISC:

[list]
[*] “DEFEAT” and “VICTORY” screens now display those words in red/gold (fancy!)
[*] When you flip a card, it now stays flipped for the rest of combat
[*] Zone three’s “???” name is now replaced once you see a cutscene where its name is mentioned
[*] Made some headway on some new content 😎
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.4
notes.content:
GRAPHICAL CHANGES:

[list]
[*] Made “Reduced Background Motion” setting reduce more backgrounds’ motion
[/list]
BUG FIXES:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bad interaction between Mitosis and Prototype 22 that was created last patch (oops)!  Mitosis now correctly triggers BEFORE Prototype 22, not after.
[*] Fixed a case where RNG was not seeded correctly
[*] the status “Cheap Fix” correctly adds “Affected by timestop!” to its description while you have timestop
[*] On controller, the map screen’s “BACK” button correctly displays the button icon for how to go back
[/list]

MISC:

[list]
[*] Fracture Detection’s random brittle point will no longer target cockpits if you have Cockpit Targeting
[*] The shop’s “Repair X hull” text now factors in Heal Booster into the text value.  (It was always healing correctly, this is just a clarification thing)
[*] You can no longer be offered Safety Lock if the only exhaust cards in your deck are trash
[*] Table Flip no longer grants Flippable to cards whose only left/right actions are random (no point!)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.3
notes.content:
GRAPHICAL CHANGES:

[list]
[*] The logbook now marks each character combo with the hardest difficulty you’ve beat it at
[*] Selective Memory and Second Opinions both have unique background art
[*] Fixed a rare graphical error that would make Gemini’s artifact show the wrong color (this was purely visual)
[/list]

BUG FIXES:

[list]
[*] Fixed a weird interaction between Mitosis and the zone 1 Needler elite fight
[*] Made a few shouts trigger less often
[*] A certain optional superboss now interacts more fairly with Missile Malfunction. (The old way wasn’t even technically a bug, but it didn’t feel fair!)
[*] Saving the game while you have 0 hard drive space available can no longer corrupt your save
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.2
notes.content:
BALANCE CHANGES:

[list]
[*] Table Flip and its upgrades are all 1 energy cheaper
[*] Quick Thinking B now draws +1 card, but exhausts
[*] Math.Max B no longer gives -1 energy next turn, but exhausts
[*] 00-A Mining Drill now caps at 9 shots per cannon
[/list]

GRAPHICAL CHANGES:

[list]
[*] Gave 00-A Mining Drill a unique pilot
[*] Put back a pixel that went missing
[/list]

BUG FIXES:

[list]
[*] Progress bar fixes!
[*] Artifact #87 is correctly marked in the codex now.  (If you’ve already seen the game’s finale, you may need to do it again to properly mark this as seen.)
[*] three cards have been removed from the codex temporarily, as they're not accessible at this moment
[*] added one card to the codex that should have been there already
[*] Event #26 has been correctly added to the pool
[*] In total, this should mean players can properly get 100% on all progress bars now
[*] Spawning objects inside of a wall now immediately destroys them
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Scrap Armor to sometimes not trigger correctly
[*] Shield and Temp Shield are no longer considered statuses.
[*] Mechanically, the only impact of this is that Boost’s “add X to your next status” will not be added to Shield or Temp Shield
[*] Fixed a crash from doubling Total Cache Wipe’s effect with Zero Doubler.  Feel free to double this card all you like, now
[*] Fixed a weird niche bug where Buried Relic’s self-boost could sometimes be unstunnable
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes: 1.0.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes and UI tweaks:

[list]
[*] Power Diversion now, correctly, does not nerf Strafe or Payback shots
[*] Nanofiber Hull + Heal Booster now correctly heals you for 2 at the end of every combat
[*] Salvage Arm no longer incorrectly triggers when shooting drones with shields
[*] Pressing Q/E no longer uses droneshift if there are no drones to shift
[*] The card Glissade is no longer missing from the codex
[*] A few character shouts trigger less often.  (Yes, Max, we know we have Jet Thrusters.)
[*] Controller tooltips now remember if you've turned them on/off between combats.
[*] (To prevent early players missing that they're toggleable, they will still turn themselves back on until you've beat zone 1 once.)
[*] Changed a few internal things to make modding a little bit easier
[*] Made credits easier to exit (and fixed messaging on click + hold)
[/list]
